purpose: Reconcile implementation qualification, selected/adopted result, and published website identity; preserve pending optimizations across coverage refreshes.
policy: Coverage qualification is not an adoption decision. Never select solely by newest timestamp or mix environments by min latency.
Selected historical candidate is a producer follow-up priority, not an automatic replacement of a current measurement.
Preserve actual variant/provider labels. torch-eager-control for INT4 is the verified arithmetic implementation, not original raw reference.
Keep each optimization pending until adopted identity is published and checked, or a documented rejection explains why it cannot be used.
Unmeasured/family-deferred/pilot-only rows remain pending; none are declared permanently impossible.
